comment: Each verdict compares a Lean-owned own-body semantic target and exact paper-local declaration with its selected byte-pinned paper-source bundle. These are semantic prerequisites, not additional paper-claim rows.

Sievert26SimpleAuctions.BREV.reason: Compared source-audited.tex:51-58 ('BREV(D) := sup_{p >= 0} p Pr_{X ~ D}[sum_{i=1}^m X_i >= p]' under SIEVERT26-FINITE-INDEPENDENT-MODEL-01) with the expanded target of BREV and its supporting definitions bundleTail, Profile, prob, value, and FinDist. BREV takes sSup over {p : ℝ // 0 ≤ p} of p * bundleTail D p, where bundleTail D p sums the independent product weights prob D ω = ∏ i, (D i).prob (ω i) over ω : Profile D satisfying p ≤ ∑ i, (D i).val (ω i). Because FinDist.prob_sum = 1 forces nonempty finite support per item and nonnegativity gives bundleTail D p ∈ [0, 1] vanishing above max_ω ∑ i, value D ω i, the sSup range is nonempty (0 at p = 0) and bounded above, so Real.sSup equals the exact real supremum (including m = 0 where BREV = 0). Parameterizing by [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] specializes identically to Fin m in ValidConstants and all displayed source_claim_use targets, and yields a valid strengthening in the first conjunct of universal_upper_boundSpec.

Sievert26SimpleAuctions.FinDist.reason: Compared source-audited.tex:51-58 ('tuple of independent, finitely supported probability distributions on R_{>= 0} (FinDist)') under approved model convention SIEVERT26-FINITE-INDEPENDENT-MODEL-01 with the expanded structure fields of FinDist and all displayed supporting uses (FinDist.tail, FinDist.rev, SREV, Profile, prob, value, bundleTail, BREV, Mechanism.rev, REV, ValidConstants, and all five source_claim_use specs). FinDist packages finite index size : ℕ, support values val : Fin size → ℝ with val_nonneg (0 ≤ val k), and weights prob : Fin size → ℝ with prob_nonneg (0 ≤ prob k) and prob_sum (∑ k, prob k = 1), which enforces size ≥ 1 and represents exactly the finitely supported probability distributions on ℝ_{≥ 0}. Potential duplicate val entries or zero-probability atoms aggregate additively under FinDist.tail, bundleTail, and Mechanism.rev because every consumer depends on realizations only via value D ω and weights linearly by prob, so all expectations and tail probabilities match the pushforward distribution exactly.

Sievert26SimpleAuctions.Mechanism.reason: Compared source-audited.tex:51-58 ('direct mechanisms with alloc_M : R^m -> [0,1]^m and pay_M : R^m -> R satisfying incentive compatibility (IC) and individual rationality (IR) for all nonnegative valuation vectors v, v' in R_{>= 0}^m') under SIEVERT26-FINITE-INDEPENDENT-MODEL-01 with the expanded structure fields of Mechanism, Mechanism.rev, REV, and displayed source_claim_use contexts. Mechanism ι provides alloc : (ι → ℝ) → ι → ℝ bounded in [0, 1] by alloc_nonneg and alloc_le_one for all v and i, pay : (ι → ℝ) → ℝ, IR as 0 ≤ ∑ i, v i * alloc v i - pay v for all v ≥ 0, and IC as ∑ i, v i * alloc v' i - pay v' ≤ ∑ i, v i * alloc v i - pay v for all v, v' ≥ 0. Mechanism.rev computes the independent product expectation ∑ ω : Profile D, prob D ω * M.pay (value D ω), matching E_{X ~ D}[pay_M(X)]. Generalizing Fin m to [Fintype ι] specializes directly to Fin m across all lower-bound specs and provides a valid strengthening in universal_upper_boundSpec.

Sievert26SimpleAuctions.REV.reason: Compared source-audited.tex:51-58 ('REV(D) := sup_M E_{X ~ D}[pay_M(X)]' over all direct IC and IR mechanisms on R_{>= 0}^m) under SIEVERT26-FINITE-INDEPENDENT-MODEL-01 with the expanded target of REV and its supporting definitions Mechanism, Mechanism.rev, Profile, prob, value, and FinDist. REV D takes sSup (Set.range fun M : Mechanism ι => M.rev D) where M.rev D = ∑ ω : Profile D, prob D ω * M.pay (value D ω). The range is always nonempty (the zero mechanism achieves 0) and bounded above (since val_nonneg, alloc_le_one, and ir imply M.pay (value D ω) ≤ ∑ i, value D ω i, bounding M.rev D by ∑ ω, prob D ω * ∑ i, value D ω i), so Real.sSup equals the exact real supremum (including m = 0 where REV D = 0). Parameterizing by [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] specializes identically to Fin m in ValidConstants and all displayed source_claim_use targets and validly strengthens the first conjunct of universal_upper_boundSpec.

Sievert26SimpleAuctions.SREV.reason: Compared source-audited.tex:51-58 ('SREV(D) := sum_{i=1}^m sup_{p >= 0} p Pr_{X_i ~ D_i}[X_i >= p]') under SIEVERT26-FINITE-INDEPENDENT-MODEL-01 with the expanded target of SREV and its supporting definitions FinDist, FinDist.rev, and FinDist.tail. SREV D sums (D i).rev over i : ι, where (D i).rev = sSup (Set.range fun p : {p : ℝ // 0 ≤ p} => ↑p * (D i).tail ↑p) and (D i).tail p = ∑ k, if p ≤ (D i).val k then (D i).prob k else 0. For each FinDist, the range contains 0 (at p = 0) and is bounded above by max_k (D i).val k (since tail p ≤ 1 and vanishes for p above all support values), so Real.sSup equals the exact real supremum (and SREV = 0 for empty ι). Parameterizing over [Fintype ι] specializes identically to Fin m in ValidConstants and all displayed source_claim_use targets, and gives a valid strengthening in the first conjunct of universal_upper_boundSpec.

Sievert26SimpleAuctions.cStar.reason: Compared source-audited.tex:51-58 ('c* := inf { c in R : forall m in N, forall D : Fin m -> FinDist, REV(D) <= c max{SREV(D), BREV(D)} }') under SIEVERT26-FINITE-INDEPENDENT-MODEL-01 with the expanded target of cStar, ValidConstants, all transitive definitions (FinDist, SREV, BREV, Mechanism, REV, and helpers), and its use in two_sided_bracketSpec. ValidConstants is literally {c : ℝ | ∀ (m : ℕ) (D : Fin m → FinDist), REV D ≤ c * max (SREV D) (BREV D)} and cStar := sInf ValidConstants. Because ValidConstants is nonempty (e.g. contains 2.486) and bounded below (e.g. by 1 via the single-item unit point mass where REV = SREV = BREV = 1; while m = 0 or zero-valuation instances give 0 ≤ c * 0 trivially), Real.sInf equals the exact real infimum matching the source definition.
